caption: The header stores the previous block's hash and a Merkle root over the transaction list; the next block repeats the link. Changing any transaction changes the Merkle root and therefore the header hash.

spec.title: A block and its chain link
spec.aria: A block diagram where the previous block's hash enters the 80-byte header, the header commits to a Merkle root, the Merkle root hashes the transaction list, and the next block stores this block's hash.
